import os
import openpyxl
from openpyxl.utils import range_boundaries, get_column_letter
from openpyxl.cell.cell import MergedCell

input_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/56637/1_56637_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/56637_0_95f90424/1_56637_output.xlsx"

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

# Only modify the exact answer-position ranges.
target_ranges = ["B12:B110", "C12:C23", "D12:H18"]

for rng in target_ranges:
    min_col, min_row, max_col, max_row = range_boundaries(rng)
    for row in range(min_row, max_row + 1):
        for col in range(min_col, max_col + 1):
            cell = ws.cell(row=row, column=col)
            if isinstance(cell, MergedCell):
                continue

            col_letter = get_column_letter(col)

            # Rows 12:60 are the 1st Shift section.
            # Rows after 60 are the 2nd Shift section.
            # ROUNDUP is used because staffing counts must be whole employees.
            if row <= 60:
